breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Existing two-column feed; full-span headings retained

narrative.overview: YouTube-first, dark-only, phones first. Preserve native Android behavior and current tablet structure.
narrative.navigation: No browse branding toolbar. OLED black (#000000), icon-only Home, History, Search, You with accessible labels. Ease in/out while hiding down and revealing up; preserve keyboard clearance. No top section strip; former destinations including Music and Subscriptions are accessible under You.
narrative.feedback: Whole-shape pressed/focused/hovered fills preserve each control corner radius. No circular waves on text actions.
narrative.comments: Restore loaded comments and scroll offset when returning from replies.
narrative.playback: Portrait video and controls have an 8dp gap below the safe top edge; no gap in fullscreen or PiP. Overlay buttons are transparent at rest with visible icons and state feedback.
narrative.loading: Home pagination remains automatic and silent, without spinner or reserved space; retain initial placeholders and recoverable errors.
narrative.description: Use the comments-style sheet below the actual video bottom in portrait and beside video in landscape, preserving video interaction, links, timestamps, and Close/Back dismissal.
